Joins Montgomery tracts with EPA facility counts and CDC PLACES asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 residents, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired-tract count ordered by facility rate descending.
sql:
WITH facility AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS facility_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_96158b' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT
    m2.tractfips AS geoid,
    CAST(m2.casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
    CAST(m3.totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_96158b_m2_cdc m2
  JOIN session.fw_96158b_m3_cdc m3 ON m2.tractfips = m3.tractfips
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.geoid,
    t.name,
    COALESCE(f.facility_count, 0) AS facility_count,
    h.totalpopulation,
    h.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN facility f ON t.geoid = f.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON t.geoid = h.geoid
),
rated AS (
  SELECT
    geoid,
    name,
    facility_count,
    totalpopulation,
    adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
    CAST(COALESCE(facility_count, 0) / NULLIF(totalpopulation, 0) * 1000 AS DOUBLE) AS epa_facilities_per_1000_residents
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  name,
  epa_facilities_per_1000_residents,
  facility_count,
  totalpopulation,
  adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
  CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_residents, adult_asthma_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_corr,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN epa_facilities_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL AND adult_asthma_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
  geoid
FROM rated
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
